Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

unit noun

a standard amount used in measuring

also unit of measurement, unit of length, unit of weight, units

classical

Vitr. 3.1.5
Plin. NH 7.198: mēnsūrās et pondera invēnit Phīdōn Argīvus (Lewis & Short)

mēnsūra, mēnsūrae f.

noun, first declension

a measure; a unit of measurement

Other words

  • modus, modī m. — a measure

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Nep. Att. 2.6: quī modus mēnsūrae medimnus appellātur (Lewis & Short)

    modus mēnsūrae, a unit of measure.

Examples

  • nec minus mēnsūrārum ratiōnēs, quae in omnibus operibus videntur necessāriae esse, ex corporis membrīs collēgērunt, utī digitum, palmum, pedem, cubitum

    the units of measurement too, which every kind of work seems to need, they took from the parts of the body: the finger, the palm, the foot, the cubitVitr. 3.1.5

See also measure, measure, measure, weight.
